cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I saved you a front-row seat at my concert. Do you understand why it hurt?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you work might run late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I knew. I still looked at that empty seat before every song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You needed someone there who knew what this meant to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You'd heard me practise for months. Please tell me you understand why someone else couldn't fill it.

mechanism: A uses its former pupil performance lessons to make the pupil understand why its specific absence hurt.
confusable: Not seeking factual admission of absence: A wants acknowledgment that a familiar witness mattered beyond any filled seat.
comparison: Missed concert versus misunderstood job-loss message.
